2025.title: Motivational & Activity Session at L.B. Shastri Nagar
2025.description: Rev. Fr. Arul Anthony SJ and the Ashirvad CSC team visited the Spandana Study Centre at L.B. Shastri Nagar. Engaging 37 children in motivational talks, fun educational activities, and games, they distributed study materials and school supplies, concluding with cake and joyful celebrations. The entire evening of activities was anchored by Ms. Deekshitha.

2025.sideLabel: ASHIRVAD’S NEW YEAR VISIT TO SSCS.
2025.title: Spandana Expo 2025
2025.description: The Ashirvad CSC team, including its director, Rev. Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, visited the Spandana Study Centre at Ramaiah Colony, Chemmasandara 2 and Kaveri Nagar slums. They motivated 25 children for the new academic term, shared inspiring words, and concluded with cake and ice cream. The visit strengthened the bond between the team and the children, fostering a sense of community and encouragement.

2025.title: Celebrating Science and Imagination: Spandana Expo 2025
2025.description: Ashirvad’s CSC, spearheaded by Rev. Fr. Arul Anthony SJ, hosted the Science Expo 2025 at Loyola Hall, SJU, with 110 participants from 15 Spandana Study Centres. Through competitions in drawing, speeches, and science models, students showcased creativity, curiosity, and teamwork. The event concluded with prizes, refreshments, and a celebration of learning.

2025.title: Video Documentary
2025.description: Approximately 80–90 women attended a program at Loyola Hall, Ashirvad, organized in collaboration with CARE. The event included inspiring speeches, a mono-act on women’s struggles, and sessions on financial literacy and small savings groups. Each participant received a steel container, and the program concluded with refreshments and a group photo.

2025.sideLabel: VIDEO DOCUMENTARY ON ASHIRVAD AND CSC
2025.title: Workshop on MEAL
2025.description: Led by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ with support from Mr. Anand and Mr. Arockya Selva, the team scripted, filmed, and produced a documentary featuring students and volunteers from Heeranna Gudde, Veerabhadra Nagara 1 & 2, and SJU Study Centre. The documentary was showcased at the province’s annual social apostolate meeting, receiving widespread appreciation for its creativity and impact.

2025.title: Annual Meeting
2025.description: From 10th to 12th March, the team attended a workshop on Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL), gaining insights into project writing, monitoring, and reporting.

2025.sideLabel: ANNUAL MEETING OF JESUIT SOCIAL CENTRES
2025.title: Spandana Camp
2025.description: The Ashirvad team presented the video documentary at the Annual Meeting of Jesuit Social Centres in Karnataka, where over 90 staff members appreciated the creative presentation. The event provided valuable learning and inspiration regarding diverse Jesuit initiatives across the state. The Spandana Summer Camp brought together 60 children for twelve days of fun, learning, and creativity. With the direction of Fr. Arun Luis SJ and coordinated by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ and his team, activities included games, crafts, and interactive sessions. The camp concluded with a valedictory program and educational outings, leaving lasting memories. Empowering Students through AI: Smart Career Choices at Ashirvad Ashirvad hosted AI-based career assessment sessions led by Mrs. Jannifer and Mrs. Shubhashini. Guided by Fr. Arul Luis SJ and coordinated by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ and his staff, a group of selected senior students from SJU tuition centre, explored career interests through tests, one-on-one guidance, and discussions, receiving personalized advice on strengths and subject choices, leaving them motivated, reflective, and prepared for future career paths.

2025.title: Session on Film Appreciation to Sahaya Students
2025.description: Fr. Anthony Arul SJ and Mr. Arockya Selva conducted an interactive session on Film Appreciation for second- and third-year Sahaya students attending a month-long residential program in English and academics at Ashirvad. The session featured a discussion on the Kannada film Harivu, highlighting human struggle and dignity. Fr. Anthony introduced basic filmmaking concepts, story structure, and the role of climactic moments in conveying meaning. Students reflected in groups and presented their insights, enhancing critical thinking, teamwork, and public speaking.

2025.title: Igniting Young Minds: Spandana Study Centres Reopen with Joy
2025.description: Spandana Study Centres at P.K. Colony and Anjenappa Garden reopened with children, parents, and the Ashirvad CSC team. Fr. Anthony Arul SJ addressed parents, while interactive sessions and study material distribution inspired learning, strengthened community engagement, and celebrated the shared commitment to children’s education.

2025.title: Spandana Centres Reopen : Inspiring Learning and Community Spirit
2025.description: Over 100 children and 50 – 60 parents attended the reopening of Spandana Study Centres at Veerabhadranagara 1, 2, and Ganapathy Slum on 17th June 2025, under the guidance of Fr. Anthony Arul. The event featured interactive sessions, a documentary screening, parents’ orientation, and distribution of study materials, fostering enthusiasm, community participation, and commitment to children’s education.

2025.title: Spandana Study Centres at Anandapuram & Deepanjali Nagara slums
2025.description: Spandana Study Centres at Deepanjali Nagara and Anandapuram reopened with children, parents, and Ashirvad CSC team, led by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ. Interactive activities, addresses by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, and a documentary inspired learning. We were happy to have Scholastics Santhosh, Laran and Canon who interacted with students and parents. Study materials were distributed, emphasizing parental involvement and community support, marking a joyful start to the academic year.

2025.title: Spandana Study Centres: Inspiring Young Minds and Families
2025.description: Spandana Study Centres at Heeranna Gudde Slum and Vinayaka Badavane reopened with 69 children and 40 – 45 parents, spearheaded by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ. Sessions included interactive activities, a documentary screening, parents’ orientation, and distribution of learning materials, fostering enthusiasm, parental involvement, and a renewed commitment to children’s education. Spandana Shines at SJU: A Joyful Reopening of Learning and Community The SJU Spandana Study Centre reopened with 32 children, 15 mothers, and five interns. Fr. Anthony Arul SJ and his team welcomed participants, screened the Spandana documentary, conducted a parents’ orientation, and distributed learning materials. The event fostered community spirit, joy, and renewed commitment to children’s education. Under the Stars: Avalahalli Awakens with Spandana The Avalahalli – Spandana Study Centre reopened with 25 children and 15 parents. The evening included a warm welcome, a screening of the Spandana documentary by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ and his team, an engaging parents’ orientation, and the distribution of learning materials. The event fostered community spirit, hope, and a shared commitment to children’s education.

2025.title: Honouring Hearts
2025.description: A medical camp and awareness programme was held at Loyola High School, Mt. St. Joseph, co-organized by Anekal Jesuit Mission and CIRW, with active participation from Ashirvad MAIN, Karnataka Hub and under the leadership of Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, its director. Over 500 migrants benefited from free check-ups and medical support, showcasing a collective commitment to health, care, and community well-being. Honouring Hearts that Teach : A Day of Gratitude and Growth at Ashirvad The Teachers’ Day celebration at Ashirvad brought together SSC volunteers for inspiration, fun, and reflection. Fr. Arun and Fr. Arul motivated volunteers to mentor with compassion and consistency. Games, gifts, and a special lunch added joy, leaving everyone re-energized to continue serving children with dedication.

2025.title: New Centres
2025.description: Under the direction of Fr. Anthony Arul, Anand and Arockya visited four Spandana Study Centres, distributing 133 Aarunya English Speaking Workbooks and cream biscuits. The visit inspired children during exams, appreciated volunteers’ dedication, and ended joyfully with Anand’s family joining the meaningful trip.

2025.title: Field Visits and Preparation for New Centres
2025.description: At the start of the month, Mr. Anand, Mr. Arockya Selva, Sch. Sanson, and Sch. Divij (MSJ) visited Pilligena Halli and B.K. Circle slums to meet children and assess the feasibility of opening two new centres. Subsequent visits included Geethanjali Nagar, Anandapuram, the SJU Study Centre, Anjenappa Garden, and Rayapuram slums. These visits provided valuable insights into community needs and helped plan the launch of new initiatives. Field Visits and Preparation for New Centres At the start of the month, Mr. Anand, Mr. Arockya Selva, Sch. Sanson, and Sch. Divij (MSJ) visited Pilligena Halli and B.K. Circle slums to meet children and assess the feasibility of opening two new centres. Subsequent visits included Geethanjali Nagar, Anandapuram, the SJU Study Centre, Anjenappa Garden, and Rayapuram slums. These visits provided valuable insights into community needs and helped plan the launch of new initiatives

2025.title: Awareness Sessions
2025.description: Bala Mela 2025 was celebrated on 16th November at St. Joseph’s Boys’ High School Campus, Bengaluru, bringing together over 450 children from the Spandana Study Centres for a day of learning, creativity, and cultural expression. Organized by Ashirvad – Centre for Social Concern in collaboration with People Inc., SJBHS, SJCC, and SJPUC, the event featured a grand inauguration led by Chief Guest Ms. Aishani Shetty and several dignitaries.

2025.title: Awareness Sessions at Veerabadhra Nagara
2025.description: the Ashirvad Centre for Social Concern (CSC) organised awareness sessions for children at the Veerabadhra Nagara Tuition Centre. The programme was designed for students from 5th standard onwards, focusing on health and menstrual hygiene for girls and value-based life guidance for boys, with the aim of promoting holistic development. Children from various Spandana Study Centres—Veerabadhra Nagara 1 and 2, Heeranna Gudde, Ganapathy Slum, and Vinayaka Badavane—actively participated. 2024.title: Medical Camp for Migrant Families at Nagavara
2024.description: Ashirvad and the Manvi-Raichur Jesuit Mission Centre organized a medical camp at Nagavara for North Karnataka migrants. Initiated by Fr. Don and supported by St. Philomena’s Hospital, the event under the local leadership of Fr. Anthony Arul, offered free health check-ups, medicines, and welfare scheme registrations, promoting care, well-being, and community support.

2024.title: Joy and Togetherness : Christmas at Ashirvad 2024
2024.description: Ashirvad hosted a festive Christmas gathering for volunteers and staff. Guided by Fr. Arun Luis SJ and coordinated by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, and anchored by Ms. Deekshitha, and supported by Mr. Anand Rao, the event included inspiring messages, fun games, competitions, Santa Claus, and a festive lunch, leaving everyone joyful, engaged, and united in celebration.

2024.title: Unlocking Potential: English Education at Spandana Study Centres
2024.description: Ashirvad CSC distributed Aarunya Phonics Workbooks across four Spandana Study Centres, Veerabadra Nagara 1 & 2, Ganapathi Slum, and Eranna Gudde. Motivated by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, the event encouraged children to attend English classes, improve communication skills, and embrace learning with enthusiasm and dedication.

2024.title: Young Minds-SSCs
2024.description: Ashirvad CSC, directed by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, visited Ramaiah Colony Slum. Accompanied by Dot Dash Meredith and FIDES staff, they interacted with children, observed the impact of donated materials, and distributed biscuits and chocolates, bringing joy, gratitude, and reinforcing hope and learning at the study centre.

2024.title: Equipping Young Minds at SSCs :Study Material Distribution 2024
2024.description: Ashirvad CSC, under the guidance of Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, distributed study materials at Veerabadra Nagar 1 & 2, Ganapathy Slum, Heeranna Gudde, and Deepanjali Nagar centres. Children were welcomed back, motivated to study diligently, and received books and stationery, fostering hope, enthusiasm, and a strong start to the new academic year.

2024.title: Inspiring Minds at SSCs: Study Materials for Underprivileged Children
2024.description: In July 2024, Ashirvad CSC, instructed by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, the staff team including Ms. Deekshitha distributed study materials at PK Colony and Anandapuram centres. Welcoming children back after summer break, Fr. Arul motivated them to study diligently, dream big, and value the support of generous donors, fostering hope, enthusiasm, and academic growth.

2024.title: Ignatian Spirit Alive : Feast of St. Ignatius at Ashirvad
2024.description: Ashirvad celebrated the feast of St. Ignatius of Loyola with devotion and joy. Presided over by Fr. Amal SJ, the Mass highlighted Ignatian values of service and faith, preached by Fr. Dean SJ. Fr. Arun Luis SJ welcomed participants, while music, homilies, and a festive breakfast made the day memorable, inspiring all in attendance. Fr. Anthony Arul thanked all volunteers for their services.

Ashirvad CSC and CARE inaugurated the Spandana Slum Study Centre at St. Joseph’s University. Fr. Amal SJ, Fr. Arun Luis SJ, and Fr. Anthony Arul SJ inspired children with messages of dedication and learning. Independence Day skits, dances, and competitions added joy, concluding with refreshments and excitement. Ms. Deekshitha and Mr. Manohar coordinated the program.

2024.title: Celebrating Learning and Togetherness at Veerabhadranagara-1
2024.description: Veerabhadranagara-1 Spandana Study Centre hosted a joyful double celebration for Children’s Day and Fr. Anthony Arul SJ’s birthday, under the management of Ms. Deekshitha. Children and volunteers from nearby centres joined. Highlights included cake-cutting, heartfelt messages, and the distribution of laptops to Aarunya Volunteers, empowering them for phonics teaching. The event celebrated learning, service, and community spirit. Fr. Arul inspired the children with his beautiful sharing.

2024.title: Siddi Heritage and Development Program at Ashirvad
2024.description: Ashirvad organized a day-long Siddi Development Program at its campus, highlighting empowerment and cultural pride among the Siddi community from Mundgod, Uttara Kannada. Rev. Fr. Arun Luis SJ and Fr. Sweebert D’Silva SJ led inspiring sessions, while participants showcased traditional songs and dances, celebrating their heritage as Fr. Anthony Arul beautifully captured the memorable moments.

2024.title: Teacher’s Day Celebration at Spandana Study Centre
2024.description: Ashirvad (CSC) organized a joyful Teacher’s Day celebration, under the guidance of Fr. Anthony Arul at the Spandana Study Centre to honour dedicated educators. The event anchored by Ms. Deekshitha featured songs, dances, speeches, and a video by the Club for Greater Good. Chief Guest Dr. R. Shridhar inspired all, and Fr. Arun Luis appreciated teachers’ contributions. The celebration ended with gratitude and smiles. Learning & Friendship

Ashirvad (CSC) organized a joyful Teacher’s Day celebration, under the guidance of Fr. Anthony Arul at the Spandana Study Centre to honour dedicated educators. The event anchored by Ms. Deekshitha featured songs, dances, speeches, and a video by the Club for Greater Good. Chief Guest Dr. R. Shridhar inspired all, and Fr. Arun Luis appreciated teachers’ contributions. The celebration ended with gratitude and smiles.

2024.sideLabel: FASHION UTSAV AT SPANDANA STUDY CENTRES
2024.title: FacebookTwitterYoutubeInstagram
2024.description: Guided by Fr. Anthony Arul and assisted by Ms. Deekshitha, Ashirvad CSC, organized Fashion Utsav for children across Spandana Study Centres, on 14th April 2025. Kids dressed as national icons, freedom fighters, scientists, and historical figures, showcasing creativity and patriotism. With games, gifts, and tokens of appreciation, the event combined learning, fun, and inspiration, leaving participants proud and joyful. 2023.title: Knowledge & Smiles: Study Material Distribution at Spandana
2023.description: Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, with Ms. Deekshitha and Ms. Rakshitha, visited Veerabadra Nagar 2, Heeranna Gutte, Ganapathy Slum, and Deepanjali Nagara study centres. They distributed study materials, encouraged children to value education, and inspired them to work hard, leaving the students joyful, motivated, and grateful.

2023.title: Fun, Festivities, and Friendship – Bala Mela 2023
2023.description: On 3rd December, Ashirvad, with Dot Dash Meredith and St. Joseph’s institutions, hosted Bala Mela 2023 for Spandana students. Around 450 children enjoyed games, rides, cultural performances, a magic show, and received gift kits. The day celebrated joy, learning, and togetherness, leaving lasting memories for all.

2023.title: Fostering Growth Through Collaboration: Parent-Teacher Meeting
2023.description: At Avalahalli, teachers and parents discussed students’ academic progress, behaviour, and participation. Guided by Fr. Arun Luis SJ and Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, the meeting fostered open dialogue, collaboration, and trust, appreciating students’ efforts and volunteers’ commitment, reinforcing a shared dedication to nurturing a supportive learning environment.

2023.title: Collaborating for Student Success: Parent-Teacher Meeting
2023.description: A Parent-Teacher Meeting at St. Joseph’s University Tuition Centre enabled teachers and parents to discuss students’ progress and development. Guided by Fr. Arun Luis SJ and Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, the session fostered collaboration, appreciation, and support, strengthening bonds and promoting holistic growth for all children.

2023.title: Annual Day & Karnataka Rajyotsava at SJU Spandana Study Centre
2023.description: Ashirvad and Spandana celebrated Annual Day and Karnataka Rajyotsava at SJU Xavier Hall. Children performed dances, patriotic songs, and games, receiving gifts and prizes. Guided by Fr. Arun Luis SJ and Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, the event celebrated culture, achievement, and the joy of learning.

2023.title: Healthy Habits, Happy Lives: Spandana Health Awareness Session
2023.description: Ashirvad’s CSC organized a Health and Hygiene session at SJU for Spandana children. Mrs. Agatha from the Sumati Salomi Foundation engaged students on hygiene, dental care, and nutrition. Guided by Fr. Arun Luis SJ and Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, children gained practical tips and received school bags.

2023.title: Shaping Leaders: Personality and Skill Development Program
2023.description: Around 50 youth from Spandana Study Centres attended a one-day training at Ashirvad, focusing on personal growth, leadership, and skill development. Guided by Fr. Arun Luis SJ, Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, and expert facilitators, participants learned practical tools, discovered talents, and gained inspiration to grow into responsible, confident individuals.

2023.title: Compassion in Action: Medical Support for Migrant Children
2023.description: Under the guidance of Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, Ashirvad, in collaboration with the Diagharh Organization and St. Philomena’s Hospital, organized a medical camp for nearly 100 children and their mothers. Free check-ups, medicines, and health guidance were provided, fostering awareness, care, and healthier futures for the Kempapura community.

2023.title: Igniting Enthusiasm: Ramaiah Colony Motivational Program
2023.description: Ashirvad CSC, in collaboration with FIDES, organized a motivational session for Ramaiah Colony students. Led by Fr. Anthony Arul SJ and Sr. Sumi, the session included games, interactive activities, and inspiring stories, encouraging regular attendance, discipline, and dedication to studies, leaving children motivated, joyful, and eager to learn. Manohar from CARE and Bikram from CSC also assisted in this program.

2023.title: Building Leaders Through Service: Volunteer Training at SJU
2023.description: An orientation at St. Joseph’s University introduced 16 volunteers to the Spandana Study Centres’ mission. Guided by Fr. Arun Luis SJ and Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, volunteers learned about the centres’ history, goals, and their role in supporting KS Garden children, leaving them motivated, inspired, and ready to serve. 2022.title: Shaping Minds and Building Confidence – Personality Development Training for Youth
2022.description: A Personality Development Training Program was conducted for 43 youth participants. Resource persons Fr. Pradeep RS, Fr. Vishal, Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, and Bro. Joshwin Pereira SJ led sessions on self-discovery, teamwork, and leadership. The program inspired participants to reflect on their identity, dreams, and purpose, fostering confidence and responsibility.

2022.title: Leadership and Personality Development at FIDES
2022.description: A Leadership and Personality Development Program was held at FIDES, led by Fr. Edward Philip SJ. Focusing on self-discovery and leadership, the session encouraged youth to reflect on “Who am I?” and their role in society. Engaging discussions and activities inspired confidence, responsibility, and a renewed commitment to community service.

2022.title: Inspiring Visit by CSC Leadership to St. Joseph’s University Tuition Centre
2022.description: The management team of the Centre for Social Concern, including Rev. Fr. Arun Luis, Rev. Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, and Mr. Manohar, visited the tuition centre at St. Joseph’s University. They interacted with students, encouraged them to study diligently, appreciated volunteers’ efforts, and assured continued support for the centre’s growth and development.

2022.title: Igniting Hearts, Empowering Minds: Volunteers Unite at Spandana Study Centre
2022.description: The Ashirvad CSC held a meeting for SJU student volunteers at Spandana Study Centre. Rev. Fr. Arun Luis SJ and Fr. Anthony Arul SJ appreciated their dedication. Mr. Manohar of CARE shared children’s challenges. Organized by Ms. Deekshitha, the session inspired volunteers to support the holistic development of underprivileged children.

2022.title: Celebrating Together : Karam Festival Planning in Full Swing
2022.description: Rev. Fr. Anthony Arul SJ and the CSC-MAIN team met Jigani leaders and volunteers at SJU to plan the Karam festival. Discussions covered registrations, volunteer coordination, food, cultural programs, and the Eucharistic celebration. Participants enthusiastically pledged full support to make the festival a grand success.

2022.title: Empowering Women : Health and Wellness at Thubrahalli
2022.description: A local doctor led an interactive session for Thubrahalli women on physical and psycho-social health, encouraging self-care despite busy routines. Participants found it practical and uplifting, appreciating Ashirvad CSC, led by Rev. Fr. Anthony Arul SJ, for organizing this impactful initiative promoting women’s well-being.

2022.title: Ashirvad and FIDES Children’s Medical Camp
2022.description: Ashirvad CSC, in collaboration with FIDES, organized a medical camp benefiting around 100 children. Doctors from St. John’s and St. Martha’s Hospitals conducted check-ups, consultations, and health guidance. Fr. Anthony Arul and Sr. Sumi ensured smooth operations, promoting hygiene, nutrition, and overall child well-being.

2022.title: Caring Amid Celebration: Migrant Health Camp at Karam Festival
2022.description: Ashirvad CSC and MAIN, in collaboration with St. Philomena’s Hospital, organized a free medical camp for migrant workers during Bengaluru’s Karam festival. The camp offered health check-ups, consultations, and medicines, with Fr. Anthony Arul motivating participation. The initiative ensured accessible healthcare while celebrating the festival, leaving participants grateful.

2022.title: FESTIVE CHEER
2022.description: During the pandemic, Ashirvad, led by Fr. Arun Luis, courageously served the vulnerable. Alongside Fr. Prashanth Madtha, Fr. Anthony Arul, and dedicated staff, they provided essential kits and meals, ensuring no one went hungry. Their efforts offered not just sustenance, but hope and reassurance to those in need.

2022.title: Festive Cheer and Happiness with Spandana Children
2022.description: Ashirvad celebrated Christmas with 60 children from KS Garden Spandana Study Centre, filling the day with joy, games, and a special Christmas message. Rev. Fr. Arun Luis SJ welcomed everyone, while Fr. Anthony Arul SJ organized the program. Each child received a school bag, leaving bright smiles and gratitude.

2022.title: Bala Mela 2022: A Carnival of Joy, Colours, and Friendship
2022.description: Ashirvad, with XLRI, Rotary E-Club, and SJ Boys’ High School, hosted Bala Mela for children from 13 Spandana Study Centres. The day featured games, performances, and fun activities. Guided by Fr. Arun Luis and guests, children enjoyed prizes, gifts, and joyful memories of friendship and creativity.

2022.title: Spandana Summer Camp: Fun, Learning, and Inspiration at FIDES
2022.description: Ashirvad, with FIDES, organized a three-day summer camp for Spandana children themed “Building a Better World Together.” Activities included singing, dancing, games, and value-based sessions. Meals, gifts, and prizes delighted participants. Fr. Anthony Arul SJ and Fr. Elvis Lewis SJ motivated children, concluding the camp with inspiration and joy.

2022.title: Christmas Celebration for Spandana Volunteers
2022.description: Ashirvad celebrated Christmas with Spandana volunteers. Inspiring speeches by Fr. Arun Luis, Fr. Anthony Arul, and others motivated volunteers, while fun activities and a North-East choir performance brought joy. The event fostered festive cheer, gratitude, and a sense of community, making it truly memorable.
